items.label: Building
items.text: Karta, a voice-first desktop agent that understands Hindi, Telugu and Hinglish, with a policy engine and kill switch so it never pays or sends without asking.

items.label: Shipping
items.text: Samvaad, AI voice agents that place outbound calls, hold a natural conversation and write what was agreed to your calendar and records.

items.label: Exploring
items.text: Agents that run an Oracle Fusion implementation end to end: setups, regression testing, BI Publisher reports and cutover, all versioned like a Git repo.
